diagram_previews.alt: A cross made of five equal squares: a central square with one square attached to each of its four sides.

The cross of five unit squares, coloured as four pieces numbered 1 to 4. Two red cuts cross at right angles at the centre O: one from P, the midpoint of the left side of the top arm, to P', the midpoint of the right side of the bottom arm, and one from Q, the midpoint of the bottom side of the left arm, to Q', the midpoint of the top side of the right arm.
The four pieces 1 to 4, in the same colours, fitted together into a tilted square of side sqrt 5; the right-angle corner of each piece is a corner of the square, one of which is O.
